title: leagues list API endpoint
acceptance: GET /leagues is registered through createApiRoutes on both surfaces and appears in openapi.generated.json as /app/leagues and /v1/leagues with a new `leagues` tag

Querystring contract: limit/offset from the shared pagination schema, name, sports[], minTrackedAthletes, minAggregatedIgFollowers, megaOnly (league has >=1 tracked athlete with >=100M IG followers); sortBy is name|sport|trackedAthletes with default name asc and a stable id tiebreak

GET /leagues/filter-options is registered on the app surface only (present as /app/leagues/filter-options, absent from /v1 in openapi.generated.json) and returns the distinct sports of the leagues catalog

Reply row is exactly: id, name, sport, leagueType, country (normalized from scope; 'world'/'World' -> null), logoUrl, countryFlagUrl (parsed from metadata JSON), keyAthletes (top 5 by IG followers, each {id, name}), nationalities (distinct, sorted), trackedAthletes; meta carries limit/offset/total; empty strings become null in the mapper, never in the query

All ClickHouse access composes hypequery builders: new_vertical.leagues is read through a CTE that applies .final(); athletes_cache aggregates apply .final() with is_active = 1 and deleted_at IS NULL; rawAs appears only for scalar aggregate expressions; ESLint passes with no raw SQL
apps/api/src/db/clickhouse/schema.generated.ts is regenerated and includes new_vertical.leagues; pnpm check:generated passes (OpenAPI snapshot and api-client regenerated in the same commit)

Module tests exist and pass: routes.test.ts covers registration, surfaces, and responses through the app; colocated queries and mapper tests cover filters, sort mapping, key-athlete selection, and null normalization; pnpm --filter api lint, typecheck, and test pass
verification_cmd: pnpm --filter api exec vitest run src/modules/leagues
notes: PRD: docs/PRD.md '## Leagues list (sports vertical)'. Sources are new_vertical.leagues (16 rows, ReplacingMergeTree sorted by id) and athletes_cache only - league_rankings_snapshots is NOT used (the mock replaced metric columns with key athletes/nationalities). Athlete aggregates group by a derived league label: football_league and basketball_league match leagues.name exactly; tennis maps as tennis_tour || ' Tour'. This name-join is a documented interim until athlete-league IDs exist. No smoke_cmd by design: per the learned rules, every filter/sort variant and the count/list sibling pair must be executed through the read-only ClickHouse MCP and the row counts recorded in these notes as deltas against a baseline, not absolutes. Surfaces decision (app+v1) is user-confirmed in the PRD.
review_findings:
SHOULD_FIX:
- apps/api/src/modules/leagues/routes/list-leagues/mapper.ts:27 — `toNationalities` and `league-filter-options/mapper.ts:10` both reimplement "distinct, blank-free, collated strings" (Set + `emptyToNull` + `toSorted(compareNames)`); athletes/routes/athlete-filter-options/mapper.ts:142 is a third site. `lib/filter-options.ts` already owns collation — add `distinctSorted(values)` there and call it from both new mappers.
- apps/api/src/modules/leagues/routes/list-leagues/queries.ts:54,201-212 — four `rawAs` uses carry no why-comment (`NATIONALITIES`, and the three CTE-qualified column projections), unlike `LEAGUE_LABEL`/`KEY_ATHLETES`/`id`. apps/api/AGENTS.md requires a reason at each `rawAs`; state that CTE columns are outside the builder's type state (the wording filters.ts:24 uses).
- phases/03-leagues-api.md:36 and phases/03-leagues-api.json acceptance[4] — still require `new_vertical.leagues` be read through a CTE applying `.final()`, while the code applies FINAL at the query root. The code is right (`id` is the whole sorting key and only a join target is barred from FINAL), so amend the acceptance text rather than the query; carried over unfixed from the previous review cycle.
- apps/api/src/tests/helpers.ts:35 — the `sum` stub is outside the phase's declared `files` globs but is genuinely required by the aggregate CTE; it is only recorded in `out_of_scope_files`. Add the path to the phase's `files` so the scope declaration matches the diff.
- apps/api/src/db/clickhouse/schema.generated.ts:373 — regeneration also picked up unrelated `profile.profile_types` drift. Legitimate generator output, but call it out in the commit body so it is not read as part of the leagues contract.
- apps/api/src/modules/leagues/routes/list-leagues/types.ts:17 — `nationalities: string[]` is stronger than the source: `athletes_cache.nationality` is `Nullable(String)`, so the `groupUniqArray` projection can emit nulls. The mapper defends via `emptyToNull`, but type the row `(string | null)[]` so the defence is visibly required.
- apps/api/src/modules/leagues/routes.test.ts:121,133 — the two `filter-options` cases sit inside `describe("GET /leagues")`; move them under their own describe so a failure names the endpoint that broke.

BACKLOG_WORTHY:
- high — replace the interim name-based league join (football_league / basketball_league / concat(tennis_tour,' Tour') vs leagues.name) with a real league id on athletes_cache; a rename or a duplicate league name silently zeroes or cross-counts aggregates.
- medium — `pnpm check:generated` greps `git status`, so it can never pass at the harness gate for a contract-changing phase; replace it with a regenerate-and-diff check that does not consult git.
- low — per-column default sort direction (`ASCENDING_FIRST` + `sortBy`/`sortDirection`) is now written twice, in athletes and leagues `queries.ts`; consider one owner if a third list endpoint appears.
- low — `keyAthletes` is capped at 5 but `nationalities` is uncapped in the list reply; consider a cap or a league detail endpoint.
